result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks but lacks pedestrian refuge islands or clearly visible dedicated pedestrian signals. The wide multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians in a mixed commercial and residential environment.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are clearly visible, which may lead to uncertainty for pedestrians regarding when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area mid-crossing and reduce total exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve predictability and safety.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and physical protection like refuge islands. Large vehicles parked near the crossing and wide curb radii create visibility and speed concerns for pedestrians in this commercial area.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large red truck is parked close to the intersection, potentially blocking the view between pedestrians and oncoming or turning traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the main road, just past the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalks to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks, but lacks pedestrian refuge islands or curb extensions. The environment is primarily designed for vehicle throughput, resulting in long exposure distances for pedestrians crossing the street.
